image_description: A low-angle shot of a street sign assembly against a clear blue sky. The assembly consists of two rectangular black street name signs mounted on top of a circular white regulatory sign with a black border and a black arrow symbol pointing right. The signs are mounted on a dark vertical post. Text on the street signs appears to be in Hebrew.
